$Comment: What a player gets on their Settings tab before they choose anything, and what you fix for
everyone. Every player can still change a choice that is not Locked; a Locked choice reads
the Default here for everyone and leaves the Settings tab. A player's own choice is kept
while a lock is on, so it comes back when you lift it.
QuestTracker is the panel of a player's pinned quests. Show.Default is whether it shows for a
player who has not chosen. Spot.Locked keeps it where the server puts it, so players cannot
move it. The spots a player may pick for it are the files under
Notifications.Level is how chatty quest and achievement notices are: EveryUpdate shows each
step as it moves, Milestones shows a step only at its marks and when it is done, Finishes
shows a step only when it is done, and None shows none of them. Finished quests, rewards and
unlocks show at every level but None.
The two progress displays (XP and reputation gains, crafting progress) carry the same Show and
Spot rules in their own files under Server/ZiggfreedCommon/HudPanels/, in a Player group.
To change a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'Default' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/player-settings.json with only the leaves you want different, for
